eoe.text: Infinite Guideline is the eternity column that Pinnacle built when it came to Sothera, opening the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

As war closed in, Vondam warned Mantis that both sides would blockade the eternity column, and he said he would destroy the station to stop an artifact from escaping; Mantis resigned as its director and Checkmate inherited the post.

Vondam predicted that his former student would come there to steal an eternity drive, since it was the only place in the system with ferries that could lift her ship into warp, while Tezzeret planned to sell the Endstone to its maker there.

The Seriema reached Infinite Guideline, and under cover of a ceasefire both sides crowded in to receive the Endstone, but the dock lost power, the station sprang leaks and Solar Knights launched boarding craft.
On the control deck Vondam stood between Haliya and the airlock and called on her to come home, but she refused, and he degraded her and cast her out of the Free Company.
